comment: I am proposing  a text to be included «A ‘non-intelligent identifier’ carries no embedded meaning (no encoded district, cadre, or facility code) and does not change when a worker's name, employer, or location changes. This keeps the identifier stable over a worker's whole career rather than requiring reassignment whenever an underlying attribute changes. »
